summary: SOS Limited, a China-based crypto asset company, filed a Form 6-K reporting the September 22, 2026 closing of a previously disclosed private placement with certain non-U.S. persons under a securities purchase agreement dated September 15, 2026. All closing conditions were satisfied. The filing names CEO Yandai Wang as signatory but discloses no price per share, stake percentage, aggregate proceeds, use of proceeds, advisor, or board recommendation. This is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer capital-raising closure, not a special situation; watch for a later 6-K or 20-F detailing securities terms and dilution.
